mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(g.id) AS value FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.category_id = c.id AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.audit_status = 1 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.title AS title, COALESCE(SUM(b.quota), 0) AS quota, COUNT(b.id) AS bookingCount FROM course c LEFT JOIN booking b ON b.course_id = c.id AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.status IN (0, 1, 4, 5) WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.title ORDER BY quota DESC, bookingCount DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM goods WHERE deleted = 0) AS goodsView, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM course WHERE deleted = 0) AS courseView, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) FROM article WHERE deleted = 0) AS articleView
SELECT target_type AS targetType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM favorite WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY target_type ORDER BY target_type ASC

SELECT c.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(g.sales), 0) AS value FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.category_id = c.id AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS label,
DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label,
COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= #{from} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

SELECT c.id AS couponId, c.name AS name, c.received_count AS receivedCount, COALESCE(u.usedCount, 0) AS usedCount FROM coupon c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT coupon_id, COUNT(*) AS usedCount FROM user_coupon WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY coupon_id ) u ON u.coupon_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY receivedCount DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT g.craftsman_id AS craftsmanId, COALESCE(cr.real_name, '未署名') AS name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) JOIN goods g ON g.id = oi.goods_id LEFT JOIN craftsman cr ON cr.id = g.craftsman_id AND cr.deleted = 0 GROUP BY g.craftsman_id, cr.real_name ORDER BY amount DESC, quantity DESC LIMIT #{topN}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{from} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT c.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS value FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.category_id = c.id AND g.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS userTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM craftsman WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 1) AS craftsmanTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND audit_status = 1) AS goodsOnSale, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 1 AND status IN (0, 1)) AS courseOpen, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AS orderTotal, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 4)) AS payAmount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (0, 1, 4, 5)) AS bookingTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 0) AS waitGoods, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 0) AS waitCourse, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM craftsman WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 0) AS waitCraftsman, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) AS waitFeedback
